findings.claim: the missing-kmctl hint named kmctl plugin install, which is not shipped
the one-hook check looked only at hooks.json

verdict.text: All three round 1 findings are fixed and the fixes broke nothing.
The hook now names only `kmctl briefing` and `uv tool install`, both of which exist.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: lint, format and tests pass, eval rows r1 to r4 pass, "stamp green: 1eadc2b60e278cdf456f1a41742eeb114ce1641c8d8668eb0a3e06a2c911b3f8".
`claude plugin validate plugin` and `claude plugin validate .`: both print "Validation passed".
The verbs the hook names: `kmctl briefing` is listed in `kmctl --help` and exits 0 here.
The rest of the hook text names only `uv tool install` and `uv tool install --force` with the repo's own origin URL.
It no longer mentions `kmctl plugin install` or any other kmctl verb that is not shipped.
r1 test: still unpacks exactly one SessionStart entry and one hook, checks that SessionStart is the only event, and now asserts that plugin.json has no `hooks` key.
r2 to r4 tests did not change in substance and still match their fails_when.
`"timeout": 10` sits on the command hook object.
Validate accepts it, and the briefing returns well within that time.
The hint now says only how to install with uv.
f2: resolved in tests/test_plugin.py, test_plugin_has_one_sessionstart_hook, which asserts `"hooks" not in manifest`.
`claude plugin validate .` prints advice that the README has no `/plugin install` line.
The tool says this does not change the verdict, and it belongs with the plugin-install-verb or docs ticket, not this one.
